purpose: Archive accepted/rejected Kafka receipts into immutable JSONL.gz microbatches and versioned S3/MinIO manifests; optional outcome wire copy.
boundaries: Archive all Kafka accepted receipts including feature-invalid and permitted rejected HASH_ONLY evidence; no HTTP intake or discarded-body reconstruction.
Shared SDK controls durable receipts, rebalance fencing and offset commits; one-record raw manifest1.0.0 from Kafka bundle2.0.0.
No business_db/processing_db access, ML, risk, training trigger or processed-history cleanup.
External Kafka/S3 credentials and versioned bucket required for serve; offline verify/tests need no AWS. No real S3/container/rollout evidence yet.
